account.title: Account
account.unconfigured: Cloud features aren't configured on this deployment. Everything else works on this device.
account.signInExplain: Signing in is optional. It syncs your profiles, decks, presets, custom game types and settings across your devices. Without an account everything stays on this device.
account.guestNote: You're using a temporary guest account. Sign in with Google to sync.
account.sync.title: Sync
account.signOut.removeData: Remove my data from this device
account.signOut.removeDataHint: Profiles, decks, presets, custom game types and synced settings are removed from this device. Your current game stays.
account.signOut.pending: Some changes haven't synced yet. Removing data from this device now would lose them.
account.export.hint: Download a JSON file of everything stored on this device (images are not included).
account.delete.hint: Permanently deletes your account and all of its cloud data. This can't be undone.
account.delete.subscription: If you have an active subscription, cancel it first in Manage subscription. Deleting the account can't stop billing on its own if the subscription can't be reached.
account.feedbackLinkHint: Report a bug, suggest an idea, or send diagnostics
account.merge.title: This device has data too
account.merge.body: Your account already has {remote} items in the cloud and this device has {local}. How should they be combined?
account.merge.mergeHint: Keep both. When the same item exists in both places, the most recently changed version wins.
account.merge.cloudOnlyHint: Replace this device's profiles, decks, presets, game types and settings with the cloud copy.
account.feedback.title: Feedback
account.feedback.textPlaceholder: What happened, or what would you like to see?
account.feedback.emailHint: Only if you'd like a reply.
account.feedback.diagnosticsHint: App version, browser, settings, the active game type and the last 200 events of the current game.
account.feedback.preview: This is exactly what will be sent:
account.feedback.offline: You're offline. Your message is kept here; send it when you're back online.
account.feedback.unavailable: Feedback isn't available on this deployment.
account.feedback.failed: Couldn't send ({error}). Your message is kept here.
account.feedback.shareHint: Send the app link to a friend
account.feedback.shareText: TCGTempo: life & timers for any card game. Works offline.
